allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 181480352 Series I Preference Shares and 136110264 Series II Preference Shares as Bonus pursuant to Scheme of Arrangement/Amalgamation at its meeting held on August 25, 2026

allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: Siyaram Silk Mills Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Allotment of Bonus Preference Shares is 22-Aug-2026.
